profile.what: Fermentation/industrial-biotech enzyme manufacturer supplying human healthcare and nutrition, animal nutrition, baking, food processing, brewing, dairy and other industries, with 20+ years developing enzymes from microbial-scale research to commercial production.

summary.en: Group companies include ABTL, JC Biotech, Dynamic Enzymes, AST, Specialty Enzymes and evoxx technologies. Listed on Indian exchanges (ticker not confirmed in sourced content).

profile.what: Recombinant-protein and cell-culture technology platform company; developed the AXTEX-4D combinatorial-screening platform, D-CRYPT protein-expression platform, and C-QWENCE antibody library, plus Oravax, an oral VLP-based COVID-19 vaccine candidate developed with Oramed Pharmaceuticals. Partnered with the Gates Foundation on rotavirus vaccine development.

summary.en: Founded by Dr. Prabuddha Kundu (Co-founder & MD), Dr. Nupur Mehrotra (Co-founder & COO) and Avijit Das (Founder Chairman); 150+ employees. Partnerships with Oramed Pharmaceuticals and the Gates Foundation.
